title: Kiritani Haruka — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, this is my room.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, it's so cute...!
Ichi, look at all the penguins!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and the decor's so modern...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Here, feel free to use these cushions.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they're also penguin-themed.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's Haruka for you!
She's covered all her bases.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't do it on purpose, but I sort of just end up buying these things when I see them, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We know how much you love penguins.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey...! She's got some weights and stuff hidden amongst her flock of penguins!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Dumbbells, one of those stretchy things for working out your core and... What are these? They look like little track hurdles...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Those are push-up stands.
They're supposed to help you do them properly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Little track hurdles...
That's so cute, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Hey, I didn't know how else to describe them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you two finally got a chance to visit. I was hoping this would happen when we were still classmates.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I doubt there was much we could've done since we're all so busy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If anything I'm really happy that you decided to invite us over today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Now that we're in different classes, we probably won't get as many chances to talk or do things together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly♪ That's why you inviting us over now feels even more special than before!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, I'm really glad I did...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I actually sort of blamed myself for not making this happen sooner...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Changing classes usually means hanging out with new friends, groups and classmates, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I understand that it's an important time for everyone as they try to get settled in...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's not really a problem for me because of how good I am at making new friends♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I joined my last class partway through the year, but I still ended up becoming friends with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd forgotten all about that since you so quickly ended up becoming the beating heart of our class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See what I mean♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm not as good at making new friends as Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I've also made a couple already, so you don't have to be so careful with us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I care about my new friends, but I also care a lot about my existing ones.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Look at me. What am I doing...?
I'm getting all worked up over nothing.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I mean, these two...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Were the first friends I made as a regular high schooler.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Haruka!
Can I try using your ab-blaster thing?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, but do you know how to use it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uhh... You're supposed to roll forward on it and roll back to your original position, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Get into a kneeling pose, place the roller in front of you and move yourself forward on it as slowly as you can while engaging your core.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Slowly... Slowly...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, you're doing pretty well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, try stretching your arms out in front of your head.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My arms... I-I'm trying...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hnnng... N-No, I give up...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... My body's shaking like crazy! How am I supposed to get myself back to where I was?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, just maintaining that position for as long as possible can also be a good workout.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really? Then, you don't necessarily have to roll yourself back to your original position?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, you should give it a try!
After that, we'll have Ms. Haruka show us how to do it right!♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Doesn't the instructor usually go first...?
Still, Saki, you tried your best, so I guess I should as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, Ms. Haruka...
Is there anything else I should keep in mind?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
Since you're asking...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, no hints!
You gotta do this without anyone's help!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. She got us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll still try my best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You can do it, Ichika.
